_comment: Tickers to collect comparable-sales growth for -- the retail and restaurant subset of advisor_universe.json, not the whole universe: fetching every universe ticker's earnings-release exhibit to look for a phrase that only retailers/restaurants use would spend most of the SEC rate-limit budget on companies that were always going to return 'not_found'. Derived once from public/data/advisor.json's screen_universe sector/industry classification (2026-08-27 snapshot) for the Yahoo industries: Apparel Retail, Department Stores, Discount Stores, Home Improvement Retail, Internet Retail, Grocery Stores, Specialty Retail, Luxury Goods, Auto & Truck Dealerships (retail) and Restaurants. A company's sector/industry classification changes rarely enough that this list does not need to be regenerated every run; regenerate by re-filtering a fresh screen_universe snapshot on the same industry set if it drifts.
